data.title: Pronouns — Starter · Lesson 2
data.subject: pronouns
data.lyrics:
¡Dale!

[Hook]
Rainy morning… Mañana lluviosa  
I’m at home… Estoy en casa  
Let’s learn… Aprendamos  
English, Spanish… Inglés, español  
Join me, let’s go.

[Verse]
We… Nosotros  
Sitting by the window, watching the rain fall slow.  
You (plural, informal)… Vosotros  
Playing games, laughing, time flies, you know.  
They (feminine)… Ellas  
Sipping coffee, talking, stories to unfold.  
You (plural, formal/informal)… Ustedes  
Join the circle, feel the warmth, let the joy take hold.

[Hook]
Rainy morning… Mañana lluviosa  
I’m at home… Estoy en casa  
Let’s learn… Aprendamos  
English, Spanish… Inglés, español  
Join me, let’s go.

[Verse]
This (masculine)… Este  
Book in my hand, stories waiting to be read.  
That (masculine)… Ese  
Picture on the wall, memories in my head.  
Here… Aquí  
In this cozy room, where we feel so free.  
There… Allí  
Through the window, the world’s calling you and me.

[Bridge]
It’s the same… Es el mismo
